source.represents: UK Sanctions List (UKSL), FCDO, single official UK source for designations under SAMLA 2018 since 2026-01-28
source.license_note: OpenSanctions is free for non-commercial use; commercial use requires a data license.

label_definition: false positive = name-matches a UK-listed entity but differs on a hard identifier (verified by construction)
caveat: False positives only. Pair with a true-positive set and a realistic base rate before reporting accuracy.
